- Iter 7 (0.230): cashew 0.55, tofu 0.10, coconut oil 0.18, coconut cream 0.08, lemon 0.04, tapioca 0.03, xanthan 0.01, lecithin 0.01

So tofu ~0.15, cashew ~0.5 seems best. Let me fine-tune near iter 5.
